nom: Oak Essentials Refining Face Mask with Blue Tansy

avis.texte: Just got this product and was curious because the consistency is like a mousse. It feels excellent and left my skin soft and hydrated. Definitely recommend it for quick hydration since it can be used pretty often. "
Love the smell and the way it makes my skin feel. Have seen a reduction in pore size since using.
The Refining Mask is definitely a great choice. It is so rich and feels very beneficial to hydrate and smooth . Have enjoyed using this wonderful Oak Essentials product!
Love the smell but did leave my face a bit oily after the first several uses.
I tried one jar and I liked it so much. I went back and bought three very smooth creamy not greasy.

avis.texte: I love all the products of Oak essentials. It is true no cologne is ever needed. I have all the products just in love with every one of them.

avis.titre: I use this at least once a week
avis.texte: This is a perfect mask to deep clean and reduce pores. I love the scent and the fact that it's gentle to my skin - so glad the add this to my Oak routine!

My skin loves this mask. I'm new to tretinoin & this has been helping with my occasional dry patches & irritation. I use it a few times a week alternating with the honey mask. Oak essentials are my new must haves!!
The Refining Mask feels light and easy to use as it states in the description Great for desert weather
I love this product as I see immediate tightening of my pores.

Was so happy for the Refining Mask to arrive Used it the first night and it was exactly what the product description described So easy to use and felt light perfect for the desert!!! A great addition to my Oak Essentials products you can't go wrong
I love this mask! It has a soothing, cooling sensation and leaves my skin feeling smooth, hydrated, and refreshed. The scent is light and fresh. I look forward to using it every time!

I've used this refining mask twice since I've purchased it. I wish I would have taken a close up of my skin prior to using it because I believe there was a difference in the texture of my skin. I think I will take a photo before I use it next time, if I remember!

I was skeptical at first but this mask is fantastic! Reduced redness and oiliness and is great as a primer before makeup. Honestly skip your primer and just use this mask, you won't regret it. Smells amazing too.
I have combination skin and it's very sensitive. This mask makes my skin feel soft and hydrated and doesn't irritate it at all.
This is a great smoothing mask. Its cooling as well and leaves skin feeling great. I received a sample packet with a previous order and liked it so much I ordered it!

So complimentary to the ritual oil- I've been working this into my am routine with ease. I have to pre plan my morning to build in the extra ten minutes, but it's been worth it. My makeup is smoother and not creasing with this.
I love how this smells and feels , I like it at the end of the day as an easy and moisturizing mask to throw on and chill

This mask is amazing. Being a product junkie, this mask is one of the best I have tried. The blue tansy smell is fabulous and the texture of my skin is noticeable smoother and softer. I have been using it consistently for a month now and I would highly recommend it.
My skin feels so so smooth after using this mask! I love using it in the morning doing my makeup for the day.
Love how this mask makes my face feel super soft, smooth and hydrated. It's perfect pampering for the face.

Very happy with my purchase. This was initially a sample included with a purchase. I tried it out on my face and left it on for about 7minutes. Rinsed it off, which left my face feeling smooth and clean. This product has a nice fresh scent.
I love this mask, the blue tansy smells so good and it feels so refreshing. It really does appear to have a blurring effect on my pores.

I can only speak for how this works for dry skin as my skin is extremely dry. This product line as a whole has been life-changing for me. It's costly but it's effective - I have wasted more money on less-expensive products that don't work than I'll ever spend on these! I would recommend this mask and follow it up with the balancing spray and moisture balm; I wish I could attach before and after photos to show the dramatic difference they have made in my skin.

avis.titre: Luxurious; face feels fresh and renewed.
avis.texte: Added this to my regular Oak Essentials daily routine (the Hydration Heroes) and I love it! I'm a huge fan of face masks, but I'm very particular. This one is perfect. It is immediately soothing on the skin and has a cooling effect. Upon removal with a warm cloth my skin feels immediately smoother. Love this! It's so relaxing and my skin is very happy with it.

Thank you for the availability to try your product. I would purchase this product. Thank you.
Have just started using the refining mask, but it has had fast results. My face is smoother and very soft.
Felt moisturizing and gentle. Almost felt like I didn't need to wash it off
I love everything about this clean brand. Been using it for years.
This mask feels so luxurious and really does smooth out my skin. Love it!
"I am absolutely in love with this Refining Mask — it transformed my skin texture in just a few uses, leaving it smoother, clearer and so radiant. A true spa-treatment in a jar!"
Love this mask! It calms my skin and leaves it looking refreshed
Luxurious!! Love this mask so much, a great addition to my OE routine

I love this product. It has a nice whipped consistency and a little goes a long way. After using this my skin is brighter, my redness has faded, and there is a nice luminous glow. So happy I added this to my routine.
It's just a small added step but it delivers! The mask smells incredible and is both soothing and so moisturizing. Don't sleep on this one!

This Refining Mask after one use was amazing :grinning_face_with_star_eyes:! It's not heavy , I left on for 10 minutes then took a warm fresh face cloth with water and wiped it off! My skin felt like I just had a facial and the next day the texture of my skin was soft and balanced , I use this product 2x a week , my skin improves with each use !!
This is a perfect mask for my skin. I am so happy for its arrival in the line.
The best mask I've ever used. Leaves my skin softer, brighter and leaves my pores looking smaller. Use 1-2x a week and look forward to this part of my routine

The mask smells really wonderful! When I first put it on, it had a very subtle tingling sensation that was very nice. After I rinse it off, my face actually felt really soft and hydrated. That's important to me as I usually have very dry skin. I would definitely recommend this product.
The best JK mask for my skin. Easy to apply and effectively gives me a glow up!
love this mask! My skin feels so soft. Super helpful for good reset once a week to reset & cleanse your pores.
My skin has become more clear, and I have definitely noticed a reduction in pores.

avis.titre: A product that transcends them all
avis.texte: This mask is so refreshing ; my skin feels calm and soothed while it's on. Once I rinse, my skin is soft as butter.
A good mask to use in my routine, time will tell to see the results.
I loved the whipped texture. The mask left my face refreshed, hydrated and soft.

I was hesitant at first. This might be the best of all time skin mask. It's insane how incredible this product is. You're only supposed to use it twice/week. I can't wait for the next time I can use this week!

I love this product so much that I purchased a second jar when Oak had a sale. I would love it if I could buy this in a huge jar like the body balm. This stuff is magic. I have sensitive skin but I can use it every day if I have the time. I love using it in the morning especially. It give a nice little pick me up, The results are beautiful. It is a lovely addition to my Oak regime. Thank you!
I've tried many over the counter and DIY masks, but this one takes the cake! Not only does it minimize my pores, but it get rid of the gunk build-up, too. It's a keeper in my OE regimen.
As the Oak Essentials brand grows, this is a great Addition. It's gentle and effective!
Love this product… it's super lightweight and feels so good on your skin with a slight tingle . My skins looks so fresh after I use it.
This is probably my favorite product from Oak Essentials . Love using with peptide serum and ritual oil.
Love the texture of the mask and the cooling effect. Face looks great afterward
Such a nice indulgence and leaves a fresh but moist feeling on face.

avis.titre: A Drink of Water for you Skin!
avis.texte: This face mask is incredible—it feels like your skin is taking a big sip of water! The texture is super smooth and it glides right on. After using it, my skin felt refreshed and soft. The perfect addition to my skincare routine!
This mask incorporated beautifully into my morning routine. My skin feels soft, smooth , and hydrated
This product was such a pleasant surprise. It does exactly what it says, and afterwards my face was smooth, calm and luminous. My pores were not noticeable. The scent was lovely.
This smells and feels so wonderful. Quick 10 minutes for a great start to the day. And my skin looks great.
I Love how baby smooth this leaves my face. Having the menopause skin it is so refreshing to feel. I definitely recommend this product!!! Thank you guys for another amazing product.
I'm am obsessed with this mask. It's perfect for my sensitive skin leaving it brightened and beautiful after using it
I've been using the Refining Mask in the morning before applying makeup and I love how fresh and smooth it leaves my skin—it feels like a spa moment every time I apply!
This mask is so soothing and the smell is amazing! I've been using it in the mornings before my make up and it is the perfect reset. Makes the rest of my skincare and makeup go on so nicely!

avis.titre: A must for my morning routine
avis.texte: Ten minutes with the Refining Mask has become a non-negotiable in my morning routine. It wakes my skin up, smooths everything out, and makes my skin feel so good I don't even want to put makeup on. The difference after using it is huge — fresh, hydrated, and refined. Absolutely worth keeping in the rotation.
The most perfect consistency and the mask left my skin feeling so refreshed!
Cooling, hydrating and love the smell. . . love everything blue tansy related!
I've been using this mask a couple times a week in the morning and my skin has never looked better. It addresses visible pores and hydrates at the same time!
Love the smell, feels great on my skin, and makes my pores disappear. Leaves my face baby-soft.
My skin looked smooth & shiny after using it one-time, & gave me that glass-like skin without applying any products on top! Loving this mask!

My skin feels brand new with this mask! I love that these products are breastfeeding safe too! After one use, I really saw a difference! My giant pores looked so much smaller after a few days. This mask is a must for sensitive skin that craves a glow.

This is hands down my favorite mask for my combination skin. I tend to get hormonal breakouts around my chin + T-Zone; this instantly smoothed my skin like a filter! I noticed my texture improving, the inflammation from my breakouts become non-exist, and the scent made me feel like I was transported to a luxury hotel spa in Europe :person_in_steamy_room::skin-tone-3:‍:female_sign: Shared it with my teen cousin and she loves it for her breakouts, too! Amazing product.
This mask is silky smooth and leaves your skin feeling so soft and refreshed!
Even with my sensitive skin, this mask is the perfect weekly reset to make my skin feel squeaky clean, brightened, and nourished all at once -- and never stripped or irritated. A must have!

I love that this mask is completely different from the honey mask (that one is so good too) This is so airy, helps diffuse the appearance on my pores and I actually really enjoy the little tingle sensation. Another amazing product!

This mask is silky with a soft refreshing botanical scent. After using once, my skin was smoother and more hydrated. This mask is perfect to brighten, smooth, and soothe skin—it feels very refreshing, too. I love using it in the morning before makeup to prep my skin. It's a great addition to boost my skincare routine.
